name: design-tools
description: The router: one targeted design pass on UI that already exists. Reads the request in the user's own words, picks exactly one specialist skill out of eighty-seven across ui-craft, taste-skill, impeccable, Emil Kowalski, Addy Osmani's web-quality suite, ibelick and nine smaller vendors — then resolves where that skill is actually installed and loads it, so the route works from any project, not only design-studio. Carries what no single vendor has: a collision table for the twelve places where three vendors cover the same ground, read-only-before-write discipline, a hard escalation threshold to design-pipeline, a registry-driven wiki of every vendor and tool, and one direct command per tool (/design-tools:impeccable, /design-tools:typeset, …) for when the user names the tool outright.
